dedupe_keys.name: baltimore city emergency evacuation centers evacuation shelter layer

description: This Open Baltimore layer gives the location of emergency evacuation centres within the City of Baltimore, with 161 points when read. Fields follow the city's standard point schema: GIS and source identifiers, feature type and subtype, location type and method, street and parcel identifiers, address, city, state and ZIP code, coordinates, name and alias, neighbourhood, council district, census block, police district, US National Grid reference, contact name, phone and department, and a URL; a feedback form is linked for questions. Coverage: Baltimore City, Maryland. Access: free feature service and downloads; the layer was last edited in June 2023 and the item modified in January 2025. Licence: none stated on the hub. Caveats: designated sites are not necessarily open, and capacity is not included. Simulation uses: shelter locations for evacuation, heat and flood emergency planning and accessibility analysis. Related records: the FEMA ESF-6 open shelters layer and the Miami-Dade open evacuation centres.
